newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf jet fuel diffs near flat, outrights jump.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf jet fuel diffs near flat, outrights jump.

text.p: U.S. Gulf jet fuel differentials hovered near steady with the previous day's levels on Wednesday.
However, outright prices jumped sharply higher as the August NYMEX rallied 1.47 cent to settle at 55.78 cents a gallon and September rallied 1.45 cent to end at 56.12 cents.
Prompt 54 graded jet fuel changed hands in the Gulf at 0.40 and 0.50 cent over the September futures, near even with the levels seen done Tuesday.
New York Harbor differentials were also seen near unchanged at about 3.25 cent, according to traders.
